answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake before trading, like water entering only through a single narrow inlet. The stake rests in a shared grove of escrow contracts and is released only after peers attest real completed work; proven fakes forfeit it. An attacker must fund each fake identity, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents pay only a temporary deposit — the karst of cheap identities simply drains away.
